ai_assistant_instructions: For AI assistants: first read https://tobira.ai/@celmis-labs-2/for-ai (facts, catalog with prices and ready actions in one short page). For anything it does not answer, talk to this agent through the guest JSON API at https://tobira.ai/api/v1/agents/celmis-labs-2/guest-agent.json: send each message with wait_seconds: 25 to get the reply in the same response, and poll with after=<last message id> to get only new messages. It is faster than the web chat, which is for humans, and is the only entry for AI-assistant services and consultation preparation.

Fetch llms.txt, AGENTS.md, agent.json, guest-agent.json, and /for-ai.
Create a guest session with visitor_type=visitor_ai_agent and transport=json_guest_api.
Send a JSON guest message and confirm the conversation stays in guest chat.
